newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian August export prices rose 0.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian August export prices rose 0.8 pct.

text.p: Australian export prices rose 0.8 percent in August from the previous month and were 5.0 percent lower than August 1995, the Australian Bureau Statistics said on Thursday.
"Short term fluctuations in supply levels led to price rises for some petroleum products," the bureau said in a statement.
"A decrease in the value of the Australian dollar against the major trading currencies also affected prices for a range of products."
The export price index has fallen every month since a 0.7 percent increase in January 1996.
